pages.scan: Files read: the request JSON, then works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/review/page-01.png, which I opened with Read and looked at before reading any other document. The image was readable. After that I read only docs/PROMPTS.md, by grep, for the answer format. I did not open the source text, script, workflow.json, storyboard or reading-flow files. Natural reading order, left to right and top to bottom: (1) Panel 1, a full-width outdoor shot at the top. A caption box at the top left reads 'A busy day at Dr. Ananya's clinic.' A woman in a white coat with a stethoscope, teal kurta and hair bun stands in the open glass doorway under a teal awning. She smiles and gestures inward to an elderly woman in a lilac sari with a shoulder bag. At the right, two people sit on metal waiting chairs seen from behind: a man and a woman with jasmine in her braid. This panel has no dialogue. (2) Panel 2, lower left and large. A woman in a blue print kurta with a long braid sits at the reception desk. She holds a phone handset to her ear, writes in a large open register and looks flustered (sweat drop, alarm lines). Stacked ledgers are at the left and waiting patients' heads are seen from behind in the foreground. Balloon A, upper left: 'Appointments, patient details, follow-ups...' Its long tail runs down and right to the top of her head. Balloon B, to the right and lower: 'I wish everything were easier to manage!' Its short tail points down to her head. (3) Panel 3, lower right and narrow. The coated woman from panel 1 stands inside the clinic with her hand on her chin, looking thoughtful. The receptionist on the phone and two other figures are small in the background. Balloon at the top: 'Our time belongs with patients. Let's make the rest simpler.' Its tail runs down to her head.
pages.observation: Tails: both panel 2 tails clearly end at the receptionist, the only foreground speaker there. The panel 3 tail clearly ends at the coated woman's head, not at the small background figures. No speaker is ambiguous. Overlap: the panel 1 caption covers only wall, sky and foliage. None of the four text boxes covers a face, a hand, the phone, the pen, the register, the stethoscope or the doorway gesture. Balloon A's long tail crosses only the background wall and awning. Order risk (minor): balloon A and the panel 3 balloon sit at about the same height across the gutter, while balloon B sits lower. A fast reader could jump from A to the panel 3 balloon before reading B. The panel border and B's position at the right edge of panel 2 make A then B then panel 3 the more likely order, and I read it that way. Clarity notes: (a) The caption names Dr. Ananya but nothing on the page ties the name to a figure. I inferred that she is the white-coated woman from the coat and stethoscope. The receptionist is never identified, and a reader could briefly wonder whether the panel 2 speaker is Ananya. (b) In panel 3 the doctor's hand-on-chin pose and inward gaze read as private thought, but the text is in a speech balloon with no listener nearby. It is unclear whether she is speaking aloud to someone or to herself. (c) The wording 'Our time belongs with patients' reads slightly unnatural ('belongs to patients' or 'should be with patients' would be more idiomatic); I cannot judge it against the approved script, which I did not read. (d) The move from outdoors in panel 1 to the reception desk in panel 2 has no transition cue, but the shared clinic setting carries it well enough. Continuity: the doctor's bun, coat, teal kurta and stethoscope match between panels 1 and 3. The receptionist's blue kurta and braid match between panels 2 and 3. No illegible text and no reading skip were found. Items (a) and (b) should be confirmed against the script in the comparison phase.
